title: Chinese Hamster Ovary (CHO) Assay
basicDesign: Grow control cells following same procedures as treated cells with the exception that they are not treated with experimental compound
Plate 2 x 10^5 cells (approximately) in medium which selects for mutants
Count up # of mutants per plate, i.e. there are replicate plates (Xi) per experiment and across experiments
To check on survivability, plate 200 cells in standard growth medium & count # which survive; this is also replicated (Pj) for each experiment

example.note: i.e. if PE = 1.0, then mutants per 10^6 survivors equals 5.0 x mutants per 2 x 10^5 survivors (= a plate)
